items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the interviewer mentions Lorenzo Tio in a narrative about a third party ('He played in Pierron's opera string... He and Lorenzo Tio...').

ctx.x: I was deaf. I think we have, didn't he play something with Pierron? He played in Pierron's opera string.

He and Lorenzo Tio and two saxophones. He played alto saxophone and Lorenzo Tio played tenor and clarinet. Yeah, that's right. We have a picture of that. A little kid, Tio used to take what the tranchines were.

We have a picture of him. I didn't have to go to school. I think some of his last jobs were with Big Eye. I think I maybe heard him there. Never talked to him, though. Might have met him, you know. I really don't know.
